responsibility: Declares the front-end UBSan instrumentation entry points used by C-family parsing and lowering code. It exposes helpers for injecting checks around arithmetic, bounds, VLA, return, reference, and member-call operations, and for recognizing or instrumenting array references.
same_name_distinction: Provides the interface for the c-family UBSan helpers by declaring the instrumentation and query functions, whereas c-ubsan.cc contains their tree-building implementations and sanitizer-specific code generation.
